phase: P3/P4, fragment's own e2e against macrofiche
how: in fragment's worktree on branch selfhost-macrofiche (fragment-macrofiche): FRAGMENT_E2E_RUNTIME=celld CELLD_BIN=…/celld CHROME_BIN=/usr/bin/chromium FRAGMENT_E2E_CODESTORE=macrofiche MACROFICHE_BIN=target/release/macrofiche cargo xtask e2e --only codestore,create,deploy,files,sync

checks.check: a repo's name made again is 409
a call without a bearer is 401
a commit pack whose chunks interleave lands as one commit
its chunks join in order
HEAD file names the blob, its size and its last commit, with no body
GET file carries the same identity, and an etag of the blob
a listing walked a file a page names each file once, recursively, with git's last commits
a pack on a stale head is 409 precondition_failed, and nothing lands
a chunk for a delete is refused (400 invalid), and nothing lands
an upsert whose stream has no eof is 400, and nothing lands
a branch made twice is 409 the second time
a branch on an unknown base is 404
a merge on a stale live is 409
a merge that can fast-forward does: live at main's tip
a restore to a commit live never held is 412
a restore is a new commit on live with the old tree, its first parent live's tip
history is newest first, the ref's tip first
the url form is the repo's name
a refusal is a problem body with a code and a title
a preview ref lives apart: a plain read misses it, an ephemeral one finds it
a restore to live's own tip is 412
a token for another repo on this repo's path is 404
a second deploy replaces the card: another image, of the new live: this node has no browser (celld: no Browser Rendering), so it shoots no cards
the card revalidates by its tag: 304 for the current one, the new image for the one before: this node has no browser (celld: no Browser Rendering), so it shoots no cards
the preview ref is ephemeral: it pulls the code.storage fake's flag on its refs, and the node's git is macrofiche (FRAGMENT_E2E_CODESTORE; docs/self-host.md, seam 5)

two saves are two passes of one head read, one listing, and one commit each: it pulls the code.storage fake's count of the requests it answered, by caller, and the node's git is macrofiche (FRAGMENT_E2E_CODESTORE; docs/self-host.md, seam 5)

and asks code.storage nothing for four poll intervals: a commit no webhook announced waits: it pulls the code.storage fake's count of the requests it answered, and the node's git is macrofiche (FRAGMENT_E2E_CODESTORE; docs/self-host.md, seam 5)

a webhook brings the poll back to its interval too: no code store outside the run announces a commit by webhook: none registers the cell's (macrofiche's contract, question 2), so refresh and the poll move the pins
